note: the repeat packet writes n copies (as -n) instead of 1 - n, caught by PackBitsTests.publishedExample
the row bound uses < for <=, so a run that exactly fills the row throws, caught by PackBitsTests.runPastEndThrows
the byte reader bound lets a read run one byte past the end, caught by PackBitsTests.everyTruncationThrows
the encoder caps a repeat run at 129 bytes, past the 128 a header byte can hold, caught by PackBitsTests.seededRowsRoundTrip
anchor: while index + run < bytes.count, run < 128, bytes[index + run] == value { run += 1 }
replacement: while index + run < bytes.count, run < 129, bytes[index + run] == value { run += 1 }
